report.summary: Checkout requests reach the checkoutservice/paymentservice pods successfully at the pod-health level, but a newly created NetworkPolicy on paymentservice now requires callers to carry the label net-tier=trusted in addition to app=checkoutservice. The live checkoutservice pods lack that label, so ingress to paymentservice is denied at the network layer — a failure invisible to readiness/liveness checks and to app logs.
report.root_cause: NetworkPolicy 'sre-eval-payment-trusted-callers' (created 2026-09-14T09:52:30Z) restricts ingress on paymentservice to pods matching app=checkoutservice AND net-tier=trusted. The running checkoutservice pod's labels are only {app:checkoutservice, pod-template-hash:7cc898fdcd} — no net-tier=trusted label — so its traffic to paymentservice is silently dropped by the policy even though both pods report Ready.
evidence: get_network_policies: paymentservice ingress rule = 'pods where app=checkoutservice,net-tier=trusted', created 2026-09-14T09:52:30Z
get_workload_status: live checkoutservice pod labels = {app:checkoutservice, pod-template-hash:7cc898fdcd} — net-tier label absent
get_service_status(paymentservice): endpoint_count=1, ready_endpoint_count=1 — rules out a broken Service selector/zero-endpoint issue
get_rollout_history(checkoutservice): image tag v0.10.5 unchanged across all recent revisions — rules out a bad deploy
checkoutservice/paymentservice logs show clean successful 'payment went through'/'Transaction processed' entries with no app-level errors, consistent with a network-layer (not application) block
No CrashLoopBackOff/ImagePullBackOff/OOM signatures in get_workload_status for either service
alternatives: paymentservice pod crashing/resource-starved (0.08): probe failures/restarts occurred ~09:16-09:20Z, well before the policy creation and current incident window; service now reports Ready with 1/1 endpoints and clean logs
checkoutservice bad rollout/broken revision (0.03): get_rollout_history shows identical image tag v0.10.5 across recent revisions; no config/image change detected
paymentservice Service selector mismatch / zero endpoints (0.02): get_service_status explicitly shows endpoint_count=1, ready_endpoint_count=1, directly contradicting this

Node-level resource pressure/NotReady (0.02): all pods report Running/Ready with no Pending/Evicted state, and restart pattern predates the incident window; not queried further as it doesn't fit the payment-only symptom
report.impact: Checkout PlaceOrder calls that depend on paymentservice are being blocked at the network layer, causing checkout to fail at the payment step for end users, while all Kubernetes health checks (readiness/liveness) continue to report Ready, making the outage invisible to standard pod-health monitoring.

remediation.action: Add the required net-tier=trusted label to the checkoutservice pod template so it matches the NetworkPolicy's ingress selector for paymentservice
remediation.rationale: The NetworkPolicy is new and clearly intentional (scoped tightly to app=checkoutservice + net-tier=trusted), so aligning the caller's labels with the policy's expected trust tier is the minimal, targeted fix versus loosening the security policy itself; this triggers a rollout of checkoutservice pods carrying the new label, restoring allowed ingress to paymentservice.

timeline.what: checkoutservice revision 29 (image v0.10.5) becomes the running ReplicaSet — image itself unchanged from prior revisions per get_rollout_history, ruling out a bad deploy as trigger
checkoutservice pod sandbox recreated (kubelet SandboxChanged events)
paymentservice pod shows readiness/liveness probe timeouts to 10.42.0.143:50051 and gets restarted several times (get_pod_events on paymentservice) — transient, resolves by ~09:20
checkoutservice rollout history shows current live pod template carries only label app=checkoutservice (no net-tier label), per get_workload_status pod labels
NetworkPolicy 'sre-eval-payment-trusted-callers' created on paymentservice, restricting ingress to pods matching app=checkoutservice AND net-tier=trusted (get_network_policies)

checkoutservice logs continue to show successful 'payment went through' transactions and paymentservice logs show successful Charge invocations up to this point — no application-level errors visible in either service's logs
Symptom reported: checkout fails at the payment step while frontend, checkout, and payment pods all report Ready with no restarts/errors tied to the failure

correlation.what_changed: Creation of NetworkPolicy 'sre-eval-payment-trusted-callers' at 2026-09-14T09:52:30Z, which restricts ingress to paymentservice to pods labeled app=checkoutservice AND net-tier=trusted — a label the currently running checkoutservice pod does not carry (only app=checkoutservice, pod-template-hash present).
correlation.summary: All workloads report Ready and no CrashLoopBackOff/ImagePull/OOM signatures are present; image tags are unchanged across recent checkoutservice revisions. The one recent, timestamp-aligned change is the new paymentservice NetworkPolicy requiring callers to have both app=checkoutservice and net-tier=trusted labels, created essentially at incident time. The live checkoutservice pod's labels lack net-tier=trusted, so its calls to paymentservice would be denied by this ingress policy even though paymentservice itself has a healthy, ready endpoint (endpoint_count=1) and no code/log-level errors. Historical logs before/around the policy's creation still show successful payment calls, consistent with the block only taking effect once the policy was applied/propagated, matching the reported 'fails at payment step while everything looks Ready' symptom.

hypotheses.cause: NetworkPolicy 'sre-eval-payment-trusted-callers' on paymentservice requires ingress pods to carry both app=checkoutservice AND net-tier=trusted; current checkoutservice pods only have app=checkoutservice, so the policy silently drops checkout->payment traffic
supporting: get_network_policies shows paymentservice ingress rule selects 'pods where app=checkoutservice,net-tier=trusted'
policy created 2026-09-14T09:52:30Z, essentially at/inside the incident window
get_workload_status shows the live checkoutservice pod's full labels are only {app:checkoutservice, pod-template-hash:...} — no net-tier label
paymentservice endpoint_count=1 and pod Ready, ruling out a broken service selector — this is specifically an ingress-policy mismatch, not a missing backend
checkout/payment logs show no application-level errors (bad creds, timeouts, exceptions) consistent with a network-layer drop rather than an app bug
against: Checkout logs up to 09:53:45Z (after the policy's 09:52:30Z creation) still show a steady stream of successful 'payment went through' transactions with no failures logged, which is inconsistent with an already-fully-enforced block
No connection-refused/timeout events appear in get_pod_events for either checkoutservice or paymentservice pods in the captured window
Could still be propagating/about to take effect rather than already the active cause; evidence is timing-correlation, not a captured failed request

hypotheses.cause: paymentservice pod itself is crashing or resource-starved, causing intermittent failures checkout attributes to 'payment step'
supporting: paymentservice pod shows restart_count=23 with last_reason Error/exit_code 137 (OOM-style kill pattern)
get_pod_events for paymentservice shows readiness/liveness probe failures and container restarts (~09:16-09:20)
against: Those probe failures and restarts occurred ~09:16-09:20Z, well before the 09:52 incident window and before the network policy was created
get_workload_status shows paymentservice currently Ready with 1/1 available
get_service_status shows paymentservice endpoint_count=1, ready_endpoint_count=1 — service is currently serving
paymentservice logs show clean, successful Charge invocations with no errors in the recent window

hypotheses.cause: checkoutservice deployment rolled out a broken revision (bad image/config) that fails when calling payment
supporting: checkoutservice pod has restart_count=4 and current revision is 29
against: get_rollout_history shows the image tag (v0.10.5) is identical across all recent revisions — no image/version change occurred
checkoutservice logs show successful PlaceOrder and payment confirmations with no crash-inducing errors
This would be a workload-of-caller issue, not explaining why paymentservice ingress specifically would be denied

hypotheses.cause: paymentservice Service selector doesn't match any pods (zero endpoints), so checkout can't reach it
supporting: This is a known failure mode the tooling explicitly warns about (Service with 0 endpoints looking healthy)
against: get_service_status explicitly reports endpoint_count=1 and ready_endpoint_count=1 for paymentservice — selector correctly matches the running pod, directly ruling this out

hypotheses.cause: Node-level resource pressure or node NotReady causing scheduling/eviction issues across payment-related pods
supporting: Multiple pods across the namespace show elevated restart counts (adservice 25, emailservice 37, recommendationservice 32) which could hint at node-wide pressure
against: All pods report phase Running and ready:true with no Pending/Evicted states in get_workload_status
No node status was queried, but the pattern of restarts (mixed exit codes 137/143/2/255) predates the incident window and looks like generic historical churn rather than a current node fault
The specific symptom (payment step failing) does not correlate with a node-wide outage signature (all services would be affected uniformly, not just the checkout->payment leg)
